instruction: How many likes did all Venmo transactions, I received this year, have in total?
notes: Fixed the name clash: the predicate is now received-direction and the object is dir-received, so no object shares a name with a predicate. Read-only question task: no database changes are required, only an answer. The plan gathers the supervisor email (show_profile), the venmo password (show_account_passwords), the current date (phone.get_current_date_and_time, to derive the start-of-year threshold 2023-01-01), logs in to venmo, then calls show_transactions with direction=received, min_created_at=start of year and min_like_count=1 (paginating over page_index at runtime) and sums like_count into the answer object total-likes, which is passed to supervisor.complete_task. The single venmo-show-transactions action abstracts the pagination loop; static init facts fix the direction, threshold date and min-like-count objects so the planner selects the correct literal arguments.
